newsitem.title: GREECE: AGRICULTURAL BANK SETS EYES ON BIGGER MARKET SHARE.
newsitem.headline: AGRICULTURAL BANK SETS EYES ON BIGGER MARKET SHARE.

text.p: Agricultural Bank of Greece governor Christos Papathanasiou called for an agressive policy to boost the group's market share in the savings market, attract large clients and achieve growth in the broad range of banking services.

In a memorandum to employees, Papthanasiou asked staff to place emphasis in attracting industrial clients with new financial products as conditions in the banking market now require a new mentality -- flexibility and fast reponse.
His plan called for the expansion of lending activities beyond agriculture to trade, industry and small-scale manufacture.

Consumer credit will be available throughout Agricultural Bank's wide branch network and clients should be fully informed as to the range of products and services the group and its subsidiary companies -- leasing, mutual fund management, insurance and credit cards.
The bank will seek to attract new clients in the tobacco, fish farming, cotton-ginning and olive oil processing sectors. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
